newsitem.title: GERMANY: German advertising market to grow 2-3 pct yearly.
newsitem.headline: German advertising market to grow 2-3 pct yearly.

text.p: Germany's advertising market will grow by between two and three percent per year until the turn of the century, the Central Association of German Advertisers (ZAW) showed on Tuesday.
Publishing a survey of its 40 membership groups, the ZAW forecast that advertising spending would rise by three percent this year to 55.2 billion marks.
That represents a slight slowdown in advertising growth, but spending remains at high levels, the ZAW said.

Thirty-one percent of the ZAW's member groups said they expected turnover to rise next year -- down from 51 percent last year. Some 53 percent expected business to remain stable, up from 42 percent, while 13 percent expected a decline, up from six percent a year earlier.
